The server component has been created to display the current server timestamp on each request. The timestamp will be different on every page load since it's generated dynamically on the server side using `new Date().toISOString()`. This approach opts out of static prerendering by using Next.js's default server-side rendering behavior for the page component.

The component is now ready and the development server has been started. You can access it at http://localhost:3000 to see the timestamp update on each page refresh.
